s: strI, (hu + vic । taM lAti । lA + saMjYAyAM kan wAp .) vasantotsavaH । holI iti BAzA । iti dAyaBAgaMwIkA ॥ tadaDikaraRanyAyo yaTA । aTa holAkADikaraRam । pratIcyAnAM holAkAcAradarSanena tadarTA holAkA AcaraRIyA iti sAmAnyaviDiH kalpyate । na tu prAcyAnAmanAcaraRAt pratIcyEriti tatra padaM deyaM sAmAnyaviDinEva pratIcyAcAropapatteH । prAcyAnAmanAcArasya icCAviraheREva upapatteH । icCAvirahaSca taddeSIyapUrvvapUrvvanAcAradarSanAt । pratIcyAnAmulkAdAnAdyAcAravirahavat । na hyanAcArArTaM vedaH kalpyate । taTA ca yatra sAmAnyaSrutyA upapattistatra viSezaviDirna kalpyate gururanugantavyaH sadetivat । na hi karmmakAle tadasamBavAt tadanyakAle iti viSezaRIyam । iti aDikaraRakOmudI ॥ * ॥ anyacca । yaTA holAkADikaraRe prAcyakarttfkaholAkAnu zWAnopapattaye holAkA karttavyetyeva SrutiH kalpitA । tAvatEva tadupapatteH na tu prAcyAdiH padavatI kalpanAgOravAt tadvadatrApi arjjako aMSadvayaM gfhRIyAditi SrutiH kalpanIyA na tu pitrAdipadavatI tadayuktaM tatra prAcyakarttfkAnuzWAnasyAvaSyakalpanIyasAmAnyaSrutyEvopapatteH । na cAprAcyAnAmananuzWAnArTaM prAcyapadavatI kalpyatAmiti vAcyam । tezAmananuzWAnasyAnAcArarUpasya SrutikalpanAnimittatvAnupapatteH । iti dAyaBAgaH ॥
v: strI hu--vic taM lAti lA--ka saMjYAyAM kan । 1 vasantotsavaBede upacArAt tatkAle PAlagunapOrRamAsyAYca 1 pfzo॰ holI holikA holakA'pyatra । holAkAviDiSca AcAraprApta iti mADavAdayaH । purARAdiprasidDaH SAstramUlo'yam AcAra iti hemAdrinirRayasinDupraBftayaH । tadviDikAlO ni॰ si॰ uktOyaTA “PAlgunapOrRamAsI holikA sA ca sAyAhnavyApinI grAhyAM “sAyAhne holikAM kuryyAt pUrvAhRe krIqarna gavAmiti” vacanAditi nirRayAmfte uktam । jyotirnibanDe tu “pratipadBUtaBadrAsu yA'rcitA holikA divA । saMvatsaraYca tadrAzwraM puraM dahati sAdButam । pradozavyApinI grAhyA pUrRimA PAlgunI sadA । tasyAM BadrAmuKaM tyaktvA pUjyA holA niSAmuKe” iti nAradavacanAt pradozavyApinItyuktam । hemAdrO Badanaratne ca Bavizye “asyAM niSAgami pArTa! saMrakzyAH SiSavo॰ gfhe । gomayenopalipte ca sacatuzke gfhANgaRe” ityAdinA tatrEva tadviDAnAcca । teneyaM pUrvavidDA “SrAvaRI durganavamo dUrvA cEva hutASanI । pUrvavidDEva karttavyA SivarAtriryalerdinam iti vfhadyamabrahmavEvarttokteSca । dinadvaye pradozavyAptO parEva pUrvadine BadrAsattvAt tatra ca holikAnizeDAt taduktaM nirRayAmfte madanaratne ca purARasamuccaye “madrAyAM dIpitA holI rAzwraBaNgaM karoti vE । nagurasya Sca nEvezwA tasmAt tAM parivarjayet” । taTA “BadrAryA dve na karttavye SrAvarRIM PAlgunI taTA । SrAvaRI nfpatiM hanti grAmaM dahati PAlgunI” । taTA “dinArDAt parato'pi syAt PAlgunI pUrRimA yadi । rAtrO BadrAvasAne tu holikA dIpyate tadA iti । yadA tu pUrvadine caturdaSI pradozavyApinI paradine ca kzayavaSAt sAyAhnAt prAgeva pUrRimA samApyate tadA pUrvadine saMpUrRa rAtrO BadrAsattvAt tatra ca tannizeDAt pare'hani pratipadyeva kuryyAt । “sArdDayAmatrayaM vA syAd dvitIyadivase yadA । pratipadvardDamAnA tu tadA sA holikA smftA” iti BavizyavacanAditi nirRayAmftakAraH । madanaratne'pyevam । yat tu “vahnO vahniM parityajediti” Bavizyam । vahnO holikAyAM vahniM pratipadaM varjayedityarTaH taduktaBinnavizayamiti tatrEvoktam । anye tu tasyAM BadrAmuKaM tyaktvA kAryyA । “pradozavyApinI cet syAd yadA pUrvadine taTA । BadrAmuKaM varjayitvA holikAyAH pradIpanam” iti nAradavacanAt । “niSAgame prapUjyata holikA sarvadA buDEH । na divA pUjayedDolAM pUjitA duHKadA Bavet” iti divodAsIyavacanAt । “yAmatrayordDvayuktA cet pratipattu BavettiTiH । BadrAmuKa parityajya kAryyA holA manIziBiH” iti vidyA vinode'BiDAnAcca । BadrAmuKaM vihAya pUrvadina eva kAryye tyAhuH । BadrAmuKantu “nAqyastu paYca vadanaM gaRakAstaTEke” iti ratnamAloktaM jYeyam । SizwAcAro'pyevameva । atra ceccandragrahaRaM tadA tato'rvANniSi BadrAvarjaM pOrRamAsyAM holikAdIpanam aTa pare'hnigrastodayastadA pUrvadine BadrA varjaM rAtrO caturTayAme vizwipucCe yA holikA kAryyA । grahottaraM pratipatsattvAt tatpUrvaYca divA holAnizeDAditi divodAsacandraprakASO । vastutastu paradine pradoze pOrRamAsIsattve karmakAlasparSe caturTayAmAdi gORakAlagrahaRe mAnAmAvAdBadrABAvAcca grahaRakAla eva holA kAryyA । na ca “sarvezAmeva varRAnAM sUtakaM rAhudarSane । snAtvA karmaRi kuvIta SftamannaM vivarjayediti” nizeDAt kaTaM sUtake holeti vAcyam tasyottarArdDaSezatvAt । pUjAmantrastu “asfkapABayasantrastEH kftA tva holi! bAliSEH । atastvAM pUjayizyAmi BUte BUtipradA Bava” iti । yattu vArttikakArErholikA AcAraprAptetyuktam । tatra hemAdryAdyudAhftamavizyavacanAnyasidDAni kftvA cintA jYeyA ArttyaDikaraRavat । hutASanI malamAse na Bavati” ni॰ si॰ ।
m: होलाका (आ), f., see next.

होलाका f. (perhaps from a cry or shout or sound in singing), the spring festival at the approach of the vernal equinox (commonly called Hūlī or Holī, and said to be dedicated to Kṛṣṇa and the Gopīs; it is celebrated during the ten days preceding the full moon of the month Phālguna, when people sprinkle red powder in sport and light fires; in some parts of India the Holī festival corresponds to or immediately precedes the Dolā-yātrā q.v.), RTL. 430.
a: होलाका — 1 The spring-festival celebrated at the approach of the spring season, during the ten-but particularly three or four-days preceding the full-moon day in the month of Phālguna (commonly called Holi). --2 The full-moon day in the month of Phālguna.

dakziRAtyEH, AdInezuka svasvakurAMgataM karaYjArkAdi sTAvaradevatApUjAdikaM taddeSaprasidDam । udvfzaBayajYAdikamudIcyEH kriyate udvfzaBayajYaSca jyEzWasya pOrRaBAsyAM balIvarddAnaByarcyaDArayanti yat hi liNgyanumIyate yaTA yatra DUmo'vagatastatrEva vahniranumIyate nAnyatra taTA ca sUtram “anumAnavyavastAnAttatsaMyuktaM pramARaM syAt” asyArTaH । anumAnavyavasTAnAt DUmAdivyavasTayA vahnyAdyanumAnavyavasTAdarSanAt tatsaMyuktaM prAcyAdipadaGawitam anumeyaSrutivAkyaM pramARaM syAditi prApte rAdDAntAyoktam “viSezABAvamAtreRa prasiDyet savaDarmatA । viSezaRAt vyavasTA syAt tacca nehopapadyate” । asyArTaH viSezABAvamAtreRa hArItasmftigoBilagfhyAdO SAKiviSezapratipAdakapadABAvana tattatsmftyuktasya sarvaDarmatA sarvasADAraRI karttavyatA prasiDyet । taTA hi Candogohi goBilAdiH svaSizyAnaDyApayAmAsa te'pyanyAn CandogAnevamanyatrApi gfhyagranTAdikamuktamUhyam atastattacCAKinastattacCAKoktamAcaranti iti smftivAkyAnusAriRI SrutiH kalpanIyA । AcAre tvAha viSezaRAt prAcyAdInAM viSezavyavahAradarSanenAnumeyaSrutO prAcyAdiviSezaRapadAntarBAvAt vyavasTA syAt prAcyAdInAmeva tadAcaraRamiti viDAnavyavasTA syAt tacca nehopapadyate । ayamBAvaH sarvAcaritfzvanugatam anAcaritfByaSca vyAvfttam AkftivyaktiguRAdikaM kicit viSezaRaM na samBavati yadupAdAya holAkAdyaDikaraRaM syAt । na ca prAcIBavatvAdirUpaprAcyAdipadasamAKyA taTeti vAcyaM taddeSaBavAnAmapi kezAYcidanAcaraRAt ciravinirgatasya tattaddeSIyasya putrapOtrARAM samAKyAyAmasatyAmapi holAkA karttavyeti sAmAnyaSrutyEvopapattO prAcyAdipadaGawitaSrutikalpanamanyAyyaM gOravAt na cAprAcyAnAma nanuzWAnArTaM prAcyAdipadavatI kalpanIyA anAcaraRarUpasyA nanuzWAnasyASrutikalpakatvAt tasyecCAviraheREva samBavAt । na hi yadi SrutivihitaM syAt tadA aprAcyErapi anuzWitaM syAditi tarkayituM Sakyate holAkAyA nityatve mAnABAvena kAmyatvAt । na hi sarvameva SrutivihitaM kAmyaM sarvEH sadBiranuzWIyate na vEkasya kartturviDAnamanyasya tannizeDayati yenAprAcyAnAM nizidDAcaraRenAnizwajanakatAjYApanArTaM tatpadamarTavat syAt । atra ca SAstradIpikADikaraRamAlAdAyamAgapraBftizu prAcyAnAmiti pAWaH । prAcyAScAtra SAstrIyAH te ca sumerulaNkayormaDyeyA reKA jyItiH SAstrAdO prasidDA tasyAH pUrvadeSIyAH prAcyAH na tu gOqadeSAvaDikapUrvaMdeSIyAH । tasyAH paScimadeSIyASca pAScAttyAH । etena pratIcyAnAM taTAcaraRamiti svadeSABiprAyeREva gOqIyenodIcyena liKitaM tadDeyaM gOqIyAnAmeva Srutikalpanam apratyakzavedAnAM taTA cAvyavasTitaSrutikalpanA syAt na cAyamapi dozaH viSezakalpane Bavizyati taTA sati pArTasAraTimiSrAdiBi rnibanDfBirayamapyudBAvitaH syAt na cEvam । tasmAjjyoti rAdiSAstraprasidDaprAcyAdimAdAyEveyamASaNketi” ।

s: puM, (havanamiti । hu + “arttistumuhusriti .” uRA 01 । 139 । iti man .) paYcamahAyajYAntargatayajYaviSezaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 7 । 14 ॥ sa tu devayajYaH । yaTA, -- “aDyApanaM brahmayajYaH pitfyajYastu tarpaRam । homo dEvo valirBOto nfyajYo'tiTipUjanam ॥” iti manuH ॥ tallakzaRaM yaTA, -- “viSizwadeSAvacCinnaprakzepopahitatyAgaH ॥” iti SrIkfzRatarkAlaNkAraH ॥ * ॥ aTa nityahomaH । taduktaM somaBujagAvalyAm । “nAjaptaH sidDyate mantro nAhutaSca PalapradaH । nAnizwo yacCate kAmAn tasmAttritayamarccayet ॥ pUjayA laBate pUjAM japAt sidDirna saMSayaH । viBUtiM cAgnikAryyeRa sarvvasidDiYca vindati ॥” nIlatantre'pi । “nityahomaM pravakzyAmi sarvvArTaM yena bindati ॥ saparyyAM samyagApAdma valipUrvvaM caredviDim ॥ tato homaM tarpaRaYca caret sADakasattamaH । valivESvAdikaM cEva brAhmaRaH samupAcaret ॥ arGodakena saMprokzya tisro reKAH samAliKet । viDivadagnimAnIya kravyAdeByo namastaTA ॥ mUlamantraM samuccAryya kuRqe vA sTaRqile'pi vA । BUmO vA saMstaredvahniM vyAhftitritayena ca । svAhAntena triDA hutvA zaqaNgahavanaM caret ॥” taTA । “tato devIM samAvAhya mUlena zoqaSAhutim । hutvA stutvA namaskftya visfjedimdumaRqale ॥” SyAmAdO viSezaH । “BEravAMSca hunedazwO AjyAnvitEstilEH SuBEH । pUrvvAdidikkrameREva tato homaM samAcaret ॥” * aTa saMkzepahomaprayogaH । “kuRqevAsTaRqile vApi vIkzaRAdiBiH saMskfte । prAgagrA udagagrASca tisro reKAH samAliKet ॥” taTA ca । “vIkzaRaM mUlamantreRa SareRa tAqanaM matam । tenEva prokzaRaM proktaM varmmaRAByukzaRaM matam ॥” tato mUlamuccAryya kuRqAya namaH iti saMpUjya prAgagrA udagagrAstisro reKAH karttavyAH । prAgagrezu mukundeSapurandarAn prAdakziRyena saMpUjya udagagrAsu brahmavEvasvatendUn pUjayet । sundarIpakze tu sarvvatra zawtArI prayogaH zawtArI ca E~ hrI~ SrIM EM klIM sOH brahmaRe namaH evaM krameRa pUjayet । taTA brahmasaMhitAyAM homakuRqe । “ESAnyAM vedikAM hastavistAronnatiSAlinIm । kftvAsmin sTApayet kumBaM yaToktakramayogataH ॥ tatra saMpUjayeddevaM yaTAviDyupacArakEH । tato homaM prakurvvIta devatAsanniDAnataH ॥” tataH kuRqamaDye zawkoRavfttatrikoRaM tadvahirazwadalapadmaM tadvahiScaturasraM caturdvArasametaM liKitvA tadupari mUlena puzpAYjalIn dadyAt । sundarIpakze tu bAlayA । tataH sarvvARi praRaveRAByukzya vahneryogapIWamarccayet । tad yaTA । karRikoparyyADAraSakyAdon saMpUjya agnyAdikoRacatuzkezu o~ DarmmAya namaH o~ jYAnAya vErAgyAya ESvaryyAya pUrvvAdidikzu aDarmmAya ajYAnAya avErAgyAya anESvaryyAya maDye o~ anantAya namaH । evaM padmAya aM arkamaRqalAya dvAdaSakalAtmane namaH । uM somamaRqalAya zoqaSakalAtmane namaH । maM vahnimaRqalAya daSakalAtmane namaH । tataH keSarezu pUrvvAdimaDye ca o~ pItAya namaH । evaM SvetAyE namaH aruRAyE namaH । kfzRAyE DUmrAyE tIbrAyE sPuliNginyE rucirAyE jvAlinyE tato raM vahnyAsanAya namaH । tataH । “vAgISvarImftusnAtAM nIlendIvaralocanAm । vAgISvareRa saMyuktAM krIqABAvasamanvitAm ॥” iti DyAtvA o~ hrI~ vAgISvarAya namaH o~ vAgISvaryyE namaH । iti mantreRa paYcopacArEH saMpUjya sUryyakAntAdisamBUtaM SrotriyagehajaM vA vahnimAnayet । sandarIpakze tu kAmeSvaraM kAmeSvarIM pUjayet । gOtamIye । “pAzARaBavavahniYca yadi vAraRisamBavam । SrotriyARAM gehajaYca vanasTaM vATavA haret ॥ yadfcCAlABasaMyukto ayogyo yAgakarmmaRi । niragnibrAhmaRAllabDo hyardDalABakaro Bavet ॥ kzatrabanDoScaturTAMSaPalaM dadyAdDutASanaH । vESyAt SUdrAcca viPalaM jAyate homakarmmaRi । tasmAt sarvvaprayatnena vahnimuktaM samAharet ॥” tantrAntare । “dvijAtiBavanAdvApi vahnimAnIya sADakaH । vOzaqantena mUlena mantritaM taM vilokayet ॥ agnimAvAhayedastramantreRa tadanantaram । hU~ Paqantena mUlena kravyAdAMSaM parityajet ॥” tataH
